texto.es: Llamas y nos cuentas qué molestia o zona quieres trabajar; te ayudamos a elegir el servicio.
texto.en: You call and tell us what area or discomfort you want to work on; we help you pick the right service.

texto.es: Llegas a un ambiente tranquilo con velas, aromas suaves y batas listas para que te relajes desde que entras.
texto.en: You arrive to a calm space with candles, soft scents and robes ready so you can unwind the moment you walk in.

texto.es: Irica o el equipo trabajan según tu anatomía, enfocándose en las zonas que más lo necesitan.
texto.en: Irica or the team work with your anatomy, focusing on the areas that need it most.

texto.es: Sales relajada y con indicaciones claras de cuidado, lista para agendar tu próxima visita.
texto.en: You leave relaxed with clear aftercare tips, ready to book your next visit.

nota.es: Cada sesión se adapta a lo que necesitas. Llámanos y te ayudamos a elegir el servicio correcto.
nota.en: Every session is tailored to what you need. Call us and we will help you pick the right service.

texto.es: Masaje enfocado en aliviar tensión muscular y dolor, adaptado a las zonas que más lo necesitan.
texto.en: Massage focused on relieving muscle tension and pain, tailored to the areas that need it most.

texto.es: Presión firme sobre músculos y tejido profundo para liberar nudos y tensión acumulada.
texto.en: Firm pressure on muscles and deep tissue to release knots and built-up tension.

texto.es: Movimientos suaves y continuos pensados para bajar el estrés y dejarte completamente relajada.
texto.en: Smooth, continuous strokes designed to lower stress and leave you completely relaxed.

texto.es: Tratamientos faciales, incluida terapia de luz LED, para refrescar y cuidar la piel.
texto.en: Facial treatments, including LED light therapy, to refresh and care for your skin.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que buscas? Llámanos y te confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you are looking for? Call us and we will confirm whether we can help.

items.quote: Irica is such a talented therapist. She runs a successful business and is reliable in helping you relax and become muscle tension-free. I always feel brand new after sessions. I've been going to her for years and even got my husband to get a few massages. Strongly recommend.
I have been going to Blu Bliss for the last 10 years. I just had my facial and my skin feels and looks refreshed. Irica is very professional and knowledgeable.
Irica is truly amazing!! I've been receiving massages from her for about three months and she never disappoints. She really knows her anatomy and focuses on the areas that need extra attention.
